description: This file defines the 'Language' controller class within the OpenCart admin extension namespace. It manages operations related to extension language files, including viewing the list of languages, installing new languages, and uninstalling existing ones. The class handles input parameters, permission checks, dynamic loading of language files, and registration of controllers, models, and system folders relevant to language extensions.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class for managing extension language files in OpenCart admin panel. Provides methods for listing, installing, and uninstalling language extensions, including permission checks, dynamic loading of language resources, and registration of related controllers and models.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that outputs the list of available languages.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and compiles a list of available, installed, and default languages for display, based on files present in the extension directory and installed extensions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process of a new language extension, including permission checks, loading language files, registering controllers and models, and updating permissions.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Removes a language extension from the system, including permission checks, database updates, and potential removal of associated language files.
